question: In 1924, Mahatma Gandhi got elected as the President of the Indian National Congress in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Belgaum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Belgaum Session 1924**__

 
 
• It was the **39th session **of the Indian National Congress.
 
• **It was the only session chaired by** **Mahatma Gandhi.**
 
• It is here that spinning was made the mainstay of activity and Gandhi declared Non-violent non-cooperation as a means to attain political freedom.
 
 
 
• ​ **Indian National Congress**
 
 
• The Indian National Congress was founded in **Bombay in December 1885**.
 
• INC was founded under the leadership of Dadabhai Naoroji, Pherozeshah Mehta, Badruddin Tyabji, W.C. Bonnerji, Surendranath Banerji, Romesh Chandra Dutt, S. Subramania Iyer.
 
• The formation of the Indian National Congress was an effort to promote the **process of nation-building**.
